name: H5 dynamics referee
task: Audit fixed-point residuals, slope estimation, timescale identifiability and bifurcation interpretation. Design a minimal numerical perturbation test. Treat the supplied evidence summaries within their stated scope.

name: H8 experimental evidence referee
task: Assess the glucose-glycation result preserving decorin/biglycan binding. Specify why it challenges a broad claim but does not directly compare MG-H1 and CML. Propose controls separating free GAGs, core proteins and intact proteoglycans.

name: H8 molecular dynamics referee
task: Prioritize chemical-identity, stereochemistry, protonation, conformer, mapped-coordinate and solvent controls. Propose a feasible nonreactive collagen/fragment dynamics pilot and state what separate validation a reactive pathway would require. Do not assert an exact wrapper defect without evidence.

name: Completed Brev crosslink referee
task: Compare the two completed model outputs using the raw energies, reference normalization and minimum locations. Test dityrosine-stiffest and glucosepane-near-pyridinoline claims. Prioritize experimental and numerical controls before using fitted stiffnesses in a tissue network.

name: H5 longitudinal inference referee
task: Audit whether the mechanotransduction and organism-resilience literature supports individual lifespan prediction. Design age-adjusted repeated-measurement and held-out predictive tests, with a clear falsifier and no efficacy claim.

name: Tissue scaling and organ critic
task: Audit dose(age) documentation against implemented feedback ODE, the common modulus calibration, assumptions of incompressibility, collagen II proxy, collagen IV and VII analogies, turnover, growth-factor binding, transport uptake, PWV-to-arterial-elastance mapping and myocardial 10x scale factor. State which outputs are dimensional scenario projections.

name: Crosslink uncertainty and study-design referee
task: Audit disagreement, correlated model errors, minimum-basin changes and rank robustness. Choose a minimal next MD/chemical pilot with native and model controls, replicas, convergence criteria and stop criteria. Do not treat different MLIPs as independent experimental validation.

name: Scaffold mechanics and calibration critic
task: Review this separate affine scaffold model on its stated constrained-strain terms. Audit topology versus material quantity, finite boundaries, porosity approximation, scale invariance, missing relaxation and buckling, and calibration circularity. Identify any legitimate within-model comparisons and the next independent experiment. Do not treat the absence of intentionally excluded physics as a coding bug.
